body.name: Breath of the Deceased
body.description: This potion disturbs the rest of the dead and awakens a longing for life once more. If poured upon the pentagram hidden somewhere in the crypt, it can summon a lich.

body.description: A dirty chunk of rock streaked with pale yellow traces of sulfur.

body.name: Broken Telescope Head

body.name: Broken War Horn
body.description: This horn is a faithful replica of the one a warlord once used to lead his armies long ago. When blown atop the pentagram inscribed somewhere in the crypt, a deep, resonant sound echoes forth, calling the warlord from beyond.

body.name: Broken Wheel

body.name: Broken Wooden Barrel Fragment
